name: AG Pay
description: Request supervised purchases and receive sanitized managed-checkout outcomes through AG Pay.

agentToken.label: Agent access token
agentToken.help: Use an OpenClaw SecretRef. Plaintext is only suitable for controlled local development.

requestTimeoutMs.label: Request timeout
requestTimeoutMs.help: Timeout in milliseconds for AG Pay API calls.

outcomePollIntervalSeconds.label: Checkout outcome poll interval
outcomePollIntervalSeconds.help: Seconds between agent-scoped sanitized checkout outcome polls.

outcomeDeliveryTarget.label: Checkout outcome delivery
outcomeDeliveryTarget.help: Use last to notify the originating session's last external channel, or none for internal-only consumption.

allowSandboxCompletion.label: Allow legacy sandbox result recording
allowSandboxCompletion.help: Test-only recording for requests without a platform-managed checkout; it never executes payment.

apiUrl.description: Root URL of the AG Pay FastAPI service. HTTPS is required outside loopback.

agentToken.description: Agent bearer credential. Configure it through an OpenClaw SecretRef.

outcomePollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between sanitized managed-checkout outcome polls.

outcomeDeliveryTarget.description: Deliver a sanitized checkout outcome to the originating session's last external channel, or consume it internally without external delivery.
